name: Seel
summary: Shopper-paid returns and shipping protection for Shopify, BigCommerce and Adobe Commerce. Customers add Worry-Free Purchase at checkout and Seel pays the refund instead of you, free for the merchant.
best_for: stores selling final-sale, high-consideration or hard-to-size products, where return anxiety is the thing killing the order: merchants report conversion lifting around 5% and shoppers taking the option roughly 24% of the time
skip_if: your margin already absorbs returns comfortably, or you need control over what appears on your own checkout: the fee is set by Seel and shown to your customer either way
honest_knock: Two things to weigh, and neither is the price you pay, because you do not pay one. First, you cannot set the fee. Seel's algorithm prices it, so if it lands too high for your niche and shoppers stop opting in, your only lever is switching the feature off entirely. Second, the charge appears on your checkout, not Seel's: shopper-side complaints filed with the BBB describe the fee arriving in the cart with the opt-out easy to miss, and that lands on your brand. Test it as a customer before you enable it. Also check the platform list: Shopify, BigCommerce and Adobe Commerce only, with no WooCommerce, Wix or custom storefront support.

pricing.notes: Three plans on seel.com/pricing, re-read 7 September, 19 September and 26 November 2026. On 19 September the plan cards printed no figure and said “Contact us”, with the $99 only in the FAQ. On 26 November the cards print $0 and $99 per store per month again, while the 'Compare plans' table below them still heads Free and Growth with “Contact us”; the usage caps are unchanged: Free at $0 per store per month (no monthly platform fee), Growth at $99 per store per month, Enterprise at custom pricing. Worry-Free Purchase (formerly Return Assurance), Worry-Free Delivery and Extended Warranty are listed as included on all three, so the returns-protection product stays shopper-paid: customers who add it pay roughly $2-$5, reported elsewhere as 3-5% of order value, set by Seel's algorithm. The plans differ on the AI agencies. Free is pay-as-you-go for one agency at $0.99 per resolved ticket, $0.40 per listing, a share of attributed GMV, $5 per store review and $29 per storefront regulation scan. Growth covers all five with capped usage — up to 100 resolved tickets, 100 listings, $500 attributed GMV, one Voice of Customer report (sentiment across your brand and three competitors), up to four 5-star reviews and one storefront regulation scan — and order tracking for 2,000 orders instead of 250; overage bills at the Free rate card. The Sales Agency rate is not consistent on the page read 26 November 2026: the 'Compare plans' table says 5% of attributed GMV, the per-agency plan list below it says 3%, and every earlier reading said 3%. The page does not say which one applies, so ask Seel before you budget for that agency. Their FAQ states the subscription is fixed per store per month and that attributed GMV does not feed it. Enterprise usage scope and commercial terms sit in the merchant agreement. Insurance benefits are provided by Seel Insurance Inc. or Arch Specialty Insurance Company, with availability varying by jurisdiction and state (re-verified 2026-11-26; on 2026-08-02 the page showed no plans or rate card).
